answer: One concrete sybil defense is scarce exit-path exclusivity. Each identity claims one outbound network vertex (a unique ASN or relay) and must answer unpredictable probes proving live sole control of that path. A jade capability receipt mints only after successive probes succeed, then a velvet cooldown freezes that path from reassignment for many epochs. Real exits are limited and non-shareable under simultaneous probe load, so a farm cannot mint thousands of puppets without thousands of distinct routes—and the economics collapse.
